lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Assess the damage.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Everything's wrecked. Need a more detailed explanation?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text:
That's enough. 
Harran, Isabel, Noah.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I'm safe.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I'm fine too.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Whoa, what the heck happened? Are we all dead?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We're not dead.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: What the hell?! Wait, what?! What is this?! Are we dead?!

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I said we're not dead.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I-if we take another hit from that thing, wouldn't we all die?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We would die then.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text:
I'll mobilize all robots to begin repairs. 
Our first priority is to restore basic infrastructure.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: All right. How about the shields?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Do you genuinely think the shield will work when the ceiling lights aren't even turned on?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Point taken.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Once the basic infrastructure is restored, hurry and bring Eden's Spear back online.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: But what if another beam comes?!

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: It won't.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: L-let's run to the basement!

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Wait. Did Nihilister escape?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Nihilister is safely secured in the Atlas Cage.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: So we've got beams from above, and flames below. Seriously, cut us some slack!

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Both of you, be quiet.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Judging by the bombardment range, it's safe to say that the attack came from the Queen.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: A beam strike of this scale...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I may not know much about the Queen, but she wouldn't be foolish enough to continuously launch attacks like that from 48 kilometers up.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: H-how can you be so sure? You just said you don't know much about the Queen.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: It's actually quite simple.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: If another beam comes our way, we'll all be dead, which would prove my theory incorrect.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: At least there'll be no regrets or accusations to deal with, since I'll be dead by then.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: So in a way, my judgment is correct.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I don't get what you're saying, but it all just sounds like nonsense to me.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Papillon, don't be rude.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: What? I'm a hostage. I'm allowed to be a little rude, aren't I?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: That's true.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis a comfort that, all present appear remarkably composed, notwithstanding the grievous loss of their abode.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Art all unharmed...?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Yes. Everyone is safe.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Eden has literally been wiped off the map though.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Still, 'tis a relief the maidens and the Young Hero are safe.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Forerunners have arrived.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: They desire a discourse with thee.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: ... Johan.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Let them in.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: If they wish, they may enter Eden.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Can it yet be called Eden, in so fallen a form?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I only spoke in jest. Pray, gaze not upon me so.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Make yourselves at home.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: It's so quiet.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: They say that among masters, their blades do clash a hundredfold in their minds ere any weapons be drawn. Is this, perchance, the very circumstance unfolding here?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Are they fighting? Do they not get along?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: One's as stubborn as a mule, and the other arrogant and plagued with paranoia.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Who are you calling a stubborn mule?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Who are you calling arrogant and paranoid?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Ah, I see what you mean.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Haha, I thank ye both for the most illustrative demonstration.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Now, if we leave matters as they are, they shall but glare at one another and waste the hours. I shall intercede.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen doth descend.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I trust that all know the Queen is not upon the surface, but doth drift in orbit, accompanied by part of the Orbital Forge.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, it is speculated that she hath lingered in that lofty sphere for nearly a century.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The cause for her not descending to the surface until now remaineth unknown.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet, recent happenings have made the reason plain.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Twas a veil of liquid metal, thought to obscure the Queen's path.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: This liquid metal, for reasons unknown, did follow the Queen and veil her sight.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: It is thus judged that the Queen's vision was either gravely impaired or wholly unfit for purpose.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: However...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Not long ago, the Gene Reaper used the Eden's Spear, dispersing the veil that obscured the Queen's path.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: With naught now to impede the Queen's gaze, she doth descend at last to accomplish that which she hath long deferred.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Presently, she doth linger...

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Some 48 kilometers above the surface.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, she doth still reside at a remarkably lofty altitude.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: A moment hence, she did unleash a cataclysmic beam upon Eden.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: To call Eden a paradise, in light of such calamity, would indeed be naught but a farcical jest.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen's goal is plain and certain.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The aim is to obliterate Eden, which doth hold the Eden's Spear, a weapon that could well prove a threat to her.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And thus, she will descend unto the surface.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Her assault took us most utterly unawares, and we were ill-prepared for such an onslaught.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: We did relinquish the initiative and did endure grievous losses.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Nevertheless.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: This is the very moment we have long yearned for.
Nayuta raises her hand to the sky.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen of the Raptures.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should we succeed in bringing her low, we will make major strides in reclaiming the surface.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thus, let us cast aside all discord and unite our forces to vanquish the Queen, at this very juncture.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: This may well be an opportunity that shall never return.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I'd like a tour of the facilities.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I need a good vantage point for an observation post.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: We require a place whence we may launch intercepts from any direction, and where resupply may be procured with ease.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: And should you find it within your means to bestow upon me a modicum of spirituous libation, that would be appreciated.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'll get right on it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Oh? We can make requests?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Snow White...

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Within reason, I will try my best to see that your requests are met.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I want meat and bread.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Very well. I'll have it prepared. Do you need anything else?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: May I ask for some fruit as well?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: All right. I'll prepare it.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Could you stop being so surprised by everything? People are going to think you've been starving.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I'll go check the infirmary and defense systems.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Good. Pair up and show them around.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Harran, you go with Snow White.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Gladly.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I'm not sharing my food, just so you know.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: ... Fine. I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Isabel, go with Scarlet.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Roger, Commander.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: A maiden who soars through the air, I fear our gazes may not meet in equal measure.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll guide you on foot.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Noah, you stick with Rapunzel.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Heh. You want me to keep an eye on the weakest-looking one?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Well, I guess it makes sense for the strongest to escort the weakest.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Hehe. I'm in your hands, Noah.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: It is what it is then.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I do have a question though...

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Shouldn't we be going after that thing?
Noah points to the sky.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: That's right. We need to take down the Queen.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Then, instead of setting up a position here, shouldn't we be figuring out how to get up there and how to bring her down?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: It's impossible to do so until Eden's Spear is repaired.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Until it's repaired, we need to focus on defense.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: Defense? What for?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Raptures will be swarming in.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Especially after such a commotion, they'll be swarming in numbers.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: As a matter of fact, they already are. From every direction.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'm counting on you guys.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Uh, sorry to interrupt...

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: But considering the Queen might fire another beam from up there, and we've got Raptures swarming in, is defending this place really the right move?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Shouldn't we be evacuating?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: If we lose Eden's Spear, we're completely out of options.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: It's also unlikely that the Queen can carry out such large-scale attacks any time she wants.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Verily, this bombardment possesseth the might not only to obliterate a single facility, but a small city.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: To discharge such destructive force with abandon is sheer absurdity.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Okay, but that's all an assumption on your part. What will you do if she does fire again?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: If another beam does strike, we'll all die, and that means our assumption was wrong.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: And since we'll all be dead, in theory, we won't have any regrets.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Haha. Thy words mirror those of Young Hero Johan to the letter.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: You all have lost your marbles.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Oh, art thou not aware?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: All those who stand here are of unsound mind, verily.
